We have the ability to cheaply provide the equivalent of very good personalized human help in any language to anyone with a cellphone. This suggests some wicked problems in education, healthcare, development, etc. might now be tractable. I don't see enough ambition to solve them

I have worked on issues like financial literacy and democratizing education for years, and so much work went into trying to figure out ways to substitute for the fact that what we really needed was a well-trained human being to work with each learner. Human help never scaled.
